question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5
solution:
The correct answer is '**elevation of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage tells us that just because a leader from a marginalised community or group is promoted doesn't mean that the community as a whole will follow suit.
 
• "**Elevation of**" fits the blank in this context. "elevation of" means to raise or lift something to a higher position or status. It fits contextually because it implies an increase or promotion, which is appropriate for the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rejection of (अस्वीकृति): "Rejection" means the dismissing or refusing of a proposal, idea, etc., which does not fit the context of discussing forest fire hazards.
 
• President of (अध्यक्ष): "President" means the head of a society, council, or other organization, which does not reflect the idea of danger or harm.
 
• Exclusion of (बहिष्कार): "Exclusion" means the process of excluding or being excluded, which does not align with describing the risk posed by forest fires.
